Subject: Single-conversation removal request (RQX912)

Hi Grace,

Per our compliance team's review, we need Redwood to remove one conversation thread from the audit logs that contains PHI that was accidentally uploaded during a brief test window. The thread ID we see on our side is RQX912 — it spans a short exchange on 2026-11-02 between an Everwell test user and our QA bot.

Can you confirm the exact data you need from us to authorize this, and an estimated SLA to complete the removal? Our legal team has prepared an authorization PDF if that helps.

Data Privacy Lead
Everwell Health

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Single-conversation removal request (RQX912)

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the heads up and the screenshot. We can handle a one-off removal for a single conversation from our request logs, but we need: 1) a signed authorization on company letterhead or DocuSign that specifies the thread ID(s) and the account owner; and 2) an expected retention window override (so we mark it for immediate exclusion from analytics/audit exports).

If you can send the signed PDF, we'll start the intake review. Typical turnaround for a one-thread exclusion is 3–5 business days after verification; if there are legal or cross-region approvals it can take longer.

I copied Marcus and Lauren so they can approve the execution and schedule the operation.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Support Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Single-conversation removal request (RQX912)

Grace —

I reviewed Everwell's screenshot and the requested scope. Evergreen policy requires the signed authorization plus confirmation that this is an account-scoped removal (not system-wide). If Rachel sends the signed PDF, I can approve the operation and open a maintenance window to run the targeted expunge against request logs and the gzip archives used by our analytics pipeline.

Two notes for operations:
- We must snapshot the affected shard before expunge and store the snapshot in a retained, access-controlled bucket for 90 days for auditability.
- The expunge script will redact KV cache entries and remove any associated audit entries; it will not affect model artifacts.

Lauren — please schedule a 30-minute ops slot between 3–5pm PT today so we can run the job and confirm the post-checks.

Marcus
Sr. Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
